videos.desc: A gloved jeweler holds a sparkling diamond in tweezers over a green velvet cushion while a red-haired customer gasps in amazement at how it catches the light. The jeweler inspects the stone through a loupe, then presents a finished diamond ring on the cushion and the woman covers her mouth in delight.
videos.said: It's on fire! Hardest thing on earth.

videos.desc: In a shop stacked with colorful wax-print cloth, a woman picks a patterned roll and the seller unrolls it across a wooden table. She feels the material between her fingers, he measures and cuts two meters, and she hugs her folded piece happily.

In a clothes shop, a woman disappears behind a fitting room curtain and steps out in one outfit after another: a khaki jumpsuit that gets a thumbs down from her bored friend, a red dress, and finally a green jumpsuit that wins an excited thumbs up.
Outside a shop with blue doors, two young people dress a white mannequin in a shirt and scarf and pose its arm up. A guy then stands next to it copying its raised-arm pose while they laugh.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Arm up, hold. Which one's next? (laughing)

videos.desc: At a mirror with vanity lights, a young woman points to the small piercing holes in her ear, picks a gold hoop from a jewelry tray, fits it into an ear piercing and admires the rings in her ear with a thumbs up.
videos.said: Four tiny holes. New ring day.

videos.desc: A young woman in a blue slip dress over a white tee struts along a long white rug in a living room as if it were a fashion-show runway, posing with a hand on her hip and turning at the end while her friends film her and shout encouragement.
videos.said: Whoo! Work it! And turn. Whoo!

videos.desc: In a fabric shop stacked with cloth, two women admire a length of shiny emerald-green silk: they let it pour like water, toss it into the air, press its smooth surface to their cheeks, and laugh as it keeps sliding off the polished counter while a white cat watches.

In an animated clothing store two friends in matching beige outfits offer a blue-haired punk girl the same jacket; she refuses and builds her own bold look with a yellow checkered jacket, red scarf and purple platform boots, posing in the mirror while the amazed friends end up draped in colorful scarves.
videos.said: Wear this one, like ours. No, this is me. Wait! Me too!

videos.desc: In a sunny tailoring workshop, a young seamstress pulls a long red thread off a wooden spool while her colleague marvels at how thin it is. She threads it through fabric, sews a seam, snips the end with scissors and both hold up the finished cloth.

A woman zips up a turquoise tracksuit jacket, tightens the matching drawstring trousers and dances in an old Italian alley under laundry lines; three friends in identical turquoise tracksuits join her and they strut and squat-dance down the cobbled street together.

Two friends walk through a European old town and realize with growing shock that everyone around them wears the same yellow bucket hat - cyclists, cafe guests, grandmas, even a passing corgi. The boy gives in, grabs a yellow hat from a street stand and proudly puts it on while his friend facepalms.
videos.said: Everyone has one! And now me too!

videos.desc: A woman in a green evening gown ties a black bow tie for a man in a white dress shirt. He pulls on the black jacket, buttons it and checks himself out in a full-length mirror, clearly impressed with the finished formal look.

A woman with long braids in a bright orange and blue patterned dress stands on a sunny city street with a plain tote over one shoulder. She holds a paper gift bag open by its handles and leans over it, eyes wide and mouth open with delight at what is inside. The clip cuts to her walking down the bright concourse of a shopping centre towards the camera with three or four paper shop bags hanging from each hand, past lit shopfronts. It ends on a rising escalator: she stands with bags stacked over both forearms and holds up a patterned brown leather handbag in one hand and a large black leather holdall in the other, grinning straight at the camera.

A blonde young woman in a white sundress walks barefoot along the wet sand at the edge of the sea; shallow waves wash over her bare feet and she leaves footprints behind her; the camera pulls back to show a long line of people walking barefoot on the same shoreline.

Two young women stand facing each other on a park lawn at sunset, hands pressed together, laughing. In close-up one of them fastens a woven beaded band around the other's wrist and adjusts it. They then throw their arms around each other, one climbs onto the other's back and they spin around on the grass with the low sun behind them.

A red-haired young woman sits at a dressing-room mirror ringed with bulbs and touches up her lips. She stands and spins so the long pale-gold skirt of her dress flares out, then walks away down a dark backstage corridor holding the skirt up. A wide shot shows her alone in a spotlight on a big empty theatre stage seen from the dark auditorium. Back in close-up she is handed a bunch of red roses, holds them out towards the camera, then bows over them in front of a red velvet curtain.

A street carnival in a city of tall shuttered houses hung with bunting. A woman in a rainbow feather costume walks down the middle of the road carrying a tall banner on a pole, smiling straight ahead, with a large crowd of people walking close behind her. Drummers in matching yellow and blue tops move along the road in rows with drums strapped to them, and the balconies on both sides are packed with people watching.

In a white kitchen a woman in a navy headscarf opens the door of a tall built-in oven, turns to a baking tray of chocolate chip cookies on the counter beside her, lifts it, and slides it onto the rack inside the lit oven.

A woman in a silky champagne slip dress with a matching long satin robe stands at an open window in a Paris apartment. She sprays perfume onto her wrist, rubs her wrists together and sprays her neck, then walks slowly through the perfume mist, flicks her hair back and turns to the camera smiling. A table beside her is crowded with perfume bottles, and Paris rooftops are visible through the window.

A male model walks a fashion-show runway in a yellow denim jacket over a purple shirt and green trousers with white and yellow trainers. The catwalk is painted in soft colour blocks and rows of guests sit along both sides filming him. He walks towards the camera, turns at the end, checks the watch on his wrist and poses smiling in sunglasses.

A young woman in a beige tailored jacket over a white top stands at a perfume counter in a brightly lit shop. She holds a paper test strip to her nose, then lifts a glass bottle and sniffs it, closes her eyes, waves the scent toward her face with her hand and reaches for another bottle on the display.

On a wooden stage at dusk, under a web of small hanging bulbs, a flamenco dancer performs in a black dress whose skirt is built from tier after tier of folded red and black frills. A guitarist plays seated at the side and two women watch and clap. As she turns and stamps, the layered frills lift and swirl out around her legs, filling most of the frame.

In a brightly painted hair salon a client sits in the styling chair with a black sleeveless salon cape fastened at her neck and hanging over her shoulders and arms down to her lap. The stylist stands behind her and sprays a can of hairspray over the client's large curled updo, holding a comb in the other hand; a cloud of spray drifts over the hair. At the end the camera holds on the finished updo and the black cape covering the seated client's back.

In a small tailor's shop lined with stacks of coloured cloth, an older tailor with a tape measure round his neck measures a young man who is wearing a new navy jacket. He then folds a piece of dark fabric on his table and marks a line on it with chalk, runs the piece through a sewing machine, and brings the changed jacket back to the young man, easing it onto his shoulders and talking him through what he has made different about it.

A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.

A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.

On a narrow stone staircase between old walls in warm sunlight, a smiling young man in a white shirt stands on the steps and tosses a long roll of thin white fabric, which unrolls and billows down the stairs in soft waves while he holds the roll. Rolls of the same white cloth are stacked along both walls. A woman and two men stand against the wall, the woman raising her hands and cheering, and an older woman in a patterned sari watches from a doorway.

A bright old workshop with tall windows and a wooden floor. A young man in a blue denim shirt, brown leather apron and jeans raises his arms and unrolls a long heavy bolt of dark blue denim fabric, which flies up in a wide wave while white fluff drifts down. The fabric falls across a long wooden cutting table, and he smooths it flat with his hands. Scissors and a tape measure lie on the table. A young woman at an old sewing machine watches, shelves of folded denim fill the back and a cat sits on a bench.

A rainy outdoor fashion show on an airport apron at dusk. A young woman with short natural hair walks towards the camera down the wet runway in a black turtleneck, a very short flared orange skirt, black tights, knee-high black boots and a long black coat that swings as she moves. Guests sit on both sides, some under umbrellas, a large passenger plane stands behind them, floodlights and a lighting rig glow, confetti blows in the wind and a worker in a high-visibility jacket runs across under stormy orange clouds.

A mirror selfie in an elegant hotel corridor with a black and white marble floor. The view moves from a gold-framed mirror into the corridor. A young woman in a long emerald green satin gown holds up her phone, turns so the flowing train spreads across the floor, and smiles widely. A white cat walks onto the train. Behind her a young woman in a short black dress kicks up a leg and laughs, a brass luggage trolley stands by the wall, and glass lamps hang from the ceiling.

An elegant 1920s-style ballroom with a chandelier, a herringbone wooden floor, palms and tall French doors. A young woman in a silver fringed flapper dress dances the Charleston, kicking one leg high, then turns towards the camera, smiles and flings her arms wide. A young man in a black tuxedo and bow tie plays a trumpet, and a young woman in a dark red beaded dress plays the piano. Through the open doors an old-fashioned cream car with spoked wheels is parked.

A grand hotel lobby with a marble floor, gold chandeliers and a revolving door. A young man with curly hair walks forward in a dark suit and tie that does not fit him well: the trousers stop short above his black shoes and the jacket pulls at the shoulders. Beside him a young woman in a burgundy satin slip dress holds two glasses of water and laughs with her head thrown back, then falls behind as he walks on towards the camera. Other guests in evening clothes stand by a curved wooden reception desk.

A mirror selfie in a hotel corridor. A young woman with long dark curly hair spins in a burgundy top and skirt, and her outfit turns into a top and short skirt with a pink flamingo and green palm-leaf print exactly like the flamingo wallpaper behind her, so she almost blends into the wall. She smiles, takes photos with her phone and poses in pink heeled sandals. Behind her a porter in a burgundy uniform peeks out from beside a brass luggage trolley and stares. There is a green carpet, a gold wall lamp and a potted palm.

A young woman in a long green satin dress calmly takes a mirror selfie in a bedroom, turning her head and checking her look. Behind her, her friends in sparkly party tops have given up waiting: one lies asleep face down across the yellow bedspread, another lies stretched out on the carpet among piles of clothes and stirs, and a third sits slumped against the wall. Shoes and discarded outfits are scattered everywhere, a lamp glows on the bedside table and lights shine outside the window.

A mirror view in a clothes shop with red velvet changing room curtains and hanging rails. A smiling young woman with long braids twirls in a bright lime green tiered tulle dress and chunky white trainers, the skirt swinging out around her. Next to her a young blonde woman in a camel coat, black top and leather skirt stands with her arms folded and watches with a doubtful, frank expression. Other shoppers look through the rails behind them, and autumn trees show through the window.
